enforced_by.module_obligation: The family module MUST evaluate both strata and MUST fail closed (raise / refuse the run) if the stratified evaluation is absent, empty, or unreportable. Reporting a pooled-only soft passer is a protocol violation.
enforced_by.reason: gates.primary_n_passers is locked to the literal 'soft' by the merged Phase B validator (scripts/xau_charter_protocol.py:755, :1182) and the primary gate resolver reads only that field (:1495, :1589). The stratified requirement therefore cannot be expressed through primary_n_passers without a Phase B protocol change, which is out of scope for this freeze.
enforced_by.report_obligation: The screen artifact must emit n, PF, NP, DD per stratum plus pooled, so the fresh-evidence stratum is auditable independently.

metric_basis.asymmetry_declared: Pooled DD and per-stratum DD are computed on DIFFERENT accounting bases and compared against the SAME gates.soft.max_drawdown_pct_max. This asymmetry is unavoidable — a stratum has no pooled MTM path of its own — and is declared here rather than resolved.
metric_basis.declared_before_scoring: This basis was fixed during Phase D implementation, before any develop screen; the stratum split is unknown at declaration time.
metric_basis.expected_bindingness: The stratum equity path is strictly shorter than pooled and therefore has weakly less room to accumulate a peak-to-trough excursion. The DD component is expected to bind LESS on the fresh stratum than on pooled. The effectively binding components of the fresh-stratum soft gate are n_trades_min, profit_factor_min, and net_profit_gt.
metric_basis.n_trades_min_consequence: gates.soft.n_trades_min applies to the xau_not_cosign_at_tstar stratum on its OWN trade count. A fresh stratum holding fewer than n_trades_min trades FAILS the stratum gate, and per resolution_order the family is SCREEN_FAIL with the null unarmed and r1 unburned. This is not a waiver, is not grounds for falling back to the pooled gate, and is not grounds for lowering n_trades_min.
metric_basis.stratum_dd_detail: Per-stratum max_drawdown_pct is the drawdown of that stratum's own ordered pnl subsequence, with equity path reconstructed from that subsequence alone starting at fixed.start_balance. Trades belonging to the other stratum are omitted, not held flat.

stratified_required.rationale: The xau_cosign_at_tstar stratum is the sign-inverse of an already-observed develop result and carries no fresh evidence. Only the xau_not_cosign stratum contains events never covered by the closed family's predicate.

resolution_order.note: Pooled-only pass is NOT sufficient and must not be reported as a passer.
resolution_order.on_both_pass: One soft passer; proceed to sealed null under exogenous accounting; provisional PASS only if p <= alpha_adjusted = 0.05/9.
resolution_order.on_stratum_fail: SCREEN_FAIL — the null is NOT armed, r1 stays unburned, no sealed cycle.
resolution_order.rule: A soft pass requires BOTH the pooled soft gate AND the xau_not_cosign_at_tstar stratum soft gate.

stratified_required.rule: soft primary must pass on the xau_not_cosign_at_tstar stratum, not only pooled

stratum_definition.predicate_isolation: Reporting label ONLY. This quantity must never enter the entry predicate, sizing, SL/TP, or exit. XAU's T* bar stays outside the signal predicate as required by the hypothesis.
stratum_definition.s_reference: s is the FX predictor cosign of the same event
stratum_definition.ternary_note: The variable is ternary (+s, -s, 0); the strata are binary. Zero-return XAU T* bars are assigned to xau_not_cosign_at_tstar. This assignment is fixed here, before implementation, and is not an implementation choice.
stratum_definition.variable: sign(close_XAU(T*) - open_XAU(T*)) on the traded series, on calendar I, at T* only
stratum_definition.xau_cosign_at_tstar: XAU T* open->close is NONZERO and its sign equals s
stratum_definition.xau_not_cosign_at_tstar: everything else — explicitly INCLUDING an exactly-zero XAU T* open->close, and including sign equal to -s
